notes.title: Full Release & 5th Additional Character!!
notes.content:
[h2]"Touhou ~Red Empress Devil." Full Release！[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118126/834a520ef697a6de8390ff2eeadfeb6373c2930f.png[/img]
The full release of "Touhou ~Red Empress Devil." is now officially available on Steam!
We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all the players who have supported us since early access and have been looking forward to this day.

[h3][b]■Additional Character[/b][/h3]
Additionally, the following new characters have been implemented in this update!

[b]【Tewi Inaba】[/b]
Ability values randomly increase or decrease upon clearing a room.

[b]【Reisen Udongein Inaba】[/b]
Wave attack with reflective bullets.

[b]【Eirin Yagokoro】[/b]
Sometimes HP is restored upon clearing a room.

[b]【Keine Kamishirasawa】[/b]
A book that orbits around you to protect you from enemy barrages.

[b]【Kaguya Houraisan】[/b]
Fully restores HP upon defeating a boss.

This update will be the last to add new characters.

We hope you enjoy the enhanced "Touhou ~Red Empress Devil."!

notes.title: Fourth Wave of New Characters & Full Release Scheduled for March 7!
notes.content:
[h2]Today, we have released an update with the addition of new characters![/h2]
The following new characters have been implemented in this update!

[h3][b]【Yukari Yakumo】[/b][/h3]
Creates "gaps" within the room that automatically attack enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118126/624b0265f9dc10b7a4292dd01c1a31d5ab01312d.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]【Ran Yakumo】[/b][/h3]
Pierces enemies with a powerful laser!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118126/18de46e63296216a2f8b0a809abe24c8971a0e64.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]【Chen】[/b][/h3]
Charges forward with a claw attack!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118126/e41cac91a9426dd032978193e2aa772a743abda2.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]【Full Release Scheduled for March 7!】[/b][/h3]
The full release is scheduled for March 7!
On the same day, the final update will introduce five new characters.

※Price updated from $7.99 to $8.99 in preparation for the full release.

Thank you for your continued support of Touhou Koyakyoen ~Red Empress Devil.!

Please continue to enjoy "Touhou ~Red Empress Devil." in the future!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
・Changed to full screen on first startup.
・Changed so that the device starts in the same language as the device when first launched (English for unsupported languages)
・Changed so that objects in a room are automatically destroyed when a room is cleared.
・Changed so that coins, EXP, etc. are attracted to the player.
・Fixed a bug that caused shots to be interrupted when an enemy was killed.
・Reduced the time of hardness after a dash.
・Adjusted game balance.
・Fixed other minor bugs.

[h3]Confirmed bugs[/h3]
・SP may not be consumed when dash is used continuously.
